theatres.fullReview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. theatres.take: Mostly good reviews — the performances and direction impressed, even if the pacing didn't.
